title: Profiled Anderson--Rubin Test: Robust Inference Allowing for Direct Effects of Instruments
abstract: arXiv:2609.18150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Instrumental variable analyses often rely on the assumption that instruments affect the outcome only through the endogenous regressor. In many applications, researchers can defend only a plausible range for direct effects of instruments, while conventional sensitivity analyses may be unreliable when instruments are weak. This paper proposes the profiled Anderson--Rubin (pAR) test, which considers all direct effects within a prespecified range and retains a candidate effect whenever at least one admissible direct effect is consistent with the data. Under the maintained sampling assumptions, the procedure controls false rejection for each compatible candidate without requiring strong instruments. The paper provides practical methods for constructing confidence sets and distinguishes substantive bounds from bounds tied to the realized instrument design. translated_title: 轮廓化安德森-鲁宾检验：允许工具变量直接效应的稳健推断
translated_abstract: 工具变量分析通常依赖于工具变量仅通过内生回归变量影响结果变量这一假设。在许多应用中，研究者只能为工具变量的直接效应给出一个合理的取值范围，而当工具变量较弱时，传统的敏感性分析可能并不可靠。本文提出了轮廓化安德森-鲁宾检验，该方法考虑预定范围内的所有直接效应，只要至少存在一个可容许的直接效应与数据一致，就保留相应的候选效应。在维持的抽样假设下，该程序无需强工具变量即可对每个相容的候选效应控制错误拒绝率。本文提供了构建置信集的实用方法，并区分了实质性界限与依赖于已实现工具设计的界限。模拟研究以及在退休储蓄与教育回报方面的应用表明……
tldr: 本文提出轮廓化安德森-鲁宾检验，通过考虑工具变量直接效应在预设范围内的所有取值，实现了在弱工具变量下对工具变量直接效应稳健的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the profiled Anderson-Rubin (pAR) test, which achieves robust inference under weak instruments by considering all direct effects of instruments within a prespecified range.
